author: Heidi Kemps
description:
East Asia--and particularly Japan--has been suffering a rash of cybersecurity incidents as of late, affecting everything from major banks and cellphone service providers to city governments and small businesses. Gaming has been one of many areas targeted: between arcade games on Sega's network going offline, 11 million Capcom IDs being compromised, and a high-schooler hacking Bandai-Namco, some major publishers have been suffering a string of embarrassments.

One recent incident involved the PC launcher for the p
title: Cheeky Malware Linked To Popular Gacha Game Cracks City Security

author: Chris Compendio
description:
A character named Mandy has the attention of many Grand Theft Auto 6 players--and that appears to include Reggie Fils-Aimé, the man who used to run Nintendo of America.

Per GamesRadar, former Nintendo marketing and public relations manager Krysta Yang joked on social media that GTA 6, which is front-loaded with a lot of simulation-like busywork in the first chapter, is "adult Animal Crossing," posting images that highlight parallels between GTA 6 and Animal Crossing: New Horizons. Fils-Aimé quoted the post, saying: "If so, where's Mandy?"

It's slightly eyebrow raising that the former executive for a family-friendly company like Nintendo seems to h
title: GTA 6 Players Captivated By Mandy Apparently Include A Former Nintendo President

author: Tom Caswell
description: BOOM! A plane has crashed in the Leonida Grassrivers. Jason races over to the site of the impact to see what he can find, but he isn't the only one interested in the downed plane...
title: This Had My Jaw On The Floor | GTA 6

author: Ana Diaz
description:
Rockstar Games finally released Grand Theft Auto 6 on Thursday. The game was highly anticipated because of, well, a lot of reasons. It’s a technical marvel that can simulate anything from doomscrolling on your phone to the thrill of hitting the club in the Miami-inspired Vice City. But it's not just about what you can do in the game. Since its release, a new viral trend on social media has emerged: People are saying they are going out, hitting the bar, and dancing--all in the real world--now that men are inside playing GTA 6. 

Now that Rockstar Games has released GTA 6, a lot of cisgender men won’t be going clubbing or be out in general. (They will be inside playing the game instead.) That will give people—especially women, femmes, and nonbinary people—the perfect chance to go out and have a fun time at the bar
title: GTA 6 Is Out, And People Are Planning To Party–Outside The Game In A Much Different World

author: Joey Carr
description:
Golf is one of the most popular sports in the real state of Florida, so it's no surprise that Grand Theft Auto 6 offers plenty of ways to play golf in the fictional state of Leonida. GTA 6 offers two types of golf: mini-golf and traditional 18-hole golf, both of which are fully accessible from the start of the game.

Leonida also features multiple courses for whichever version of golf you decide to play. There are some slightly different rules for mini-golf versus regular golf, but the mechanics for either of them will make sense after a couple of holes. Below, you can see all of the golf course locations in GTA 6 and how to play like a pro.

In This Ar
title: How To Play Golf (And Mini-Golf) In GTA 6

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Actor Michael C. Hall has reacted to how GTA 6 features references to his Miami-set TV show Dexter, in which he famously played the serial killer Dexter.

Appearing on the Barstool Movies show, Hall said he was "informed" of the Easter eggs in GTA 6 about his character. "I wasn't consulted," he said with a laugh. "It's pretty cool to feel like [Dexter] has folded into the zeitgeist."

After the GTA 6 Extended Look premiered in August, people immediately spotted what
title: GTA 6 Has Dexter References, And Now Dexter Himself Has Reacted

author: Joey Carr
description:
Just like in every game before it, guns play a massive role throughout Grand Theft Auto 6. Whether you're completing a story mission, heading off on a crime spree with Jason and Lucia, or partaking in one of the many side quests, you'll need some trusty guns available in your loadout.

Luckily, GTA 6 comes stocked with a huge host of weapons for you to find or purchase in Leonida. However, some guns are locked behind story progression, while others are easy to miss when you're browsing through the selections at an Ammu-Nation store. With that in mind, here's every gun in GTA 6, along with some of the best ones to use, especially in the early game.

In
title: Best Guns In GTA 6 And All Guns To Buy

author: Joey Carr
description:
The state of Leonida is home to some of the rarest and most expensive cars we've ever seen in the Grand Theft Auto franchise. GTA 6 features over a dozen supercars, which are always the pinnacle of the vehicle food chain. While you'll likely take any supercar during the early or mid-game, you'll eventually want to drive the fastest car in GTA 6.

Driving the fastest car in Leonida will require you to acquire a legendary vehicle or wait until your character can afford one later on in the story. With GTA 6's new car-stealing restrictions, you can't just take a supercar off the streets and make it your own. However you decide to get a supercar, you'll still want to know which ones go the fastest.

Fas
title: Don’t Blink: These Are The Fastest Cars In GTA 6

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 has finally arrived, and, to the surprise of no one, it's putting up some big numbers that speak to the pent-up demand. GTA 6 sold more than 30 million copies and hit almost $4 billion on day one, but that's just the start of understanding the impact of the game's release.

For starters, the internet service provider Comcast announced that November 18--the final day of preloading--was the busiest day in the company's histo
title: GTA 6 Sets Even More Records

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
GTA 6 is an enormous hit--it's the biggest gaming release ever. Take-Two just announced that GTA 6 reach 32.5 million copies sold before release, with revenue reaching $3.79 billion through the end of the first day on sale on November 19. This makes it the biggest entertainment release--for any medium--in history, Take-Two said.

For comparison, 2013's GTA 5 hit $800 million in revenue in its first 24 hours and $1 billion after its first three days,
title: GTA 6’s Astonishing $4 Billion Day One Includes 32.5 Million Copies Sold

author: Mark Delaney
description:
I'm several hours into Rockstar's behemoth video game, and as big as the GTA 6 map is, I've seldom needed (and even less often preferred) more than two wheels to get around. Biking in GTA 6 is awesome, and it's a safe bet to say you should be doing it more than you are. 

Sure, Grand Theft Auto 6 might imply heavy use of automobiles right there in its title, and there are plenty of amazing boats, planes, and cars to find-
title: You Should Bike More (In GTA 6)

author: Chris Pereira
description:
GTA 6 may still very much be a Grand Theft Auto game, but some fundamental changes--a stronger focus on realism, money being scarce--do a lot to shake things up. Driving might not feel totally different, but the decision-making behind choosing what to drive and how reckless to be on the road give that portion of the game a much different feel. But should you prefer not to drive yourself, you do have a choice, and it doesn't involve taking taxis or relying on public transportation.

It can be easy to miss, due to how it's accessed, but there is an auto-drive option you can enable so your current character drives themselves. Here's how to enable it:

  1. Hold Down on the D-Pad while in a vehicle
  2. Press Options/Start to enable Cinematic Mode
  3. Hold Circle/B to turn on auto-drive
title: GTA 6’s Auto-Drive Feature Is Easy To Miss But Extremely Handy

author: Chris Pereira
description:
I expected Xbox Series X|S's Quick Resume to be the defining feature of this console generation, but it's been the unique features offered by PS5's DualSense controller that have actually provided the biggest edge for me. GTA 6 is not only the latest such example of this, but it's also the best example of leveraging the DualSense yet.

The controller's speaker is used for some nice touches, like hearing your phone ring or chatter on the police scanner, but as is often the case, it's the DualSense triggers that make the more meaningful difference. These are leveraged in myriad ways that can significantly enhance the experience of whatever you're doing.

For instance, the home-repair tasks you can complete early in the game see the triggers react differently based on what you're doing. It just feels more immersive for the triggers to not behave normally when you're installing s
title: GTA 6 Has The Best Use Of PS5’s DualSense Controller Yet

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
After years of waiting, GTA fans can finally play GTA 6, but some players are encountering a dreaded error code that makes the game crash or otherwise fail.

Users are reporting receiving the CE-108255-1 error code, which players might see when a game crashes mid-session or fails to load entirely. Crashing mid-game in GTA 6 would be particularly frustrating given how saves work.
title: GTA 6 Is Crashing On Some PS5s With CE-108255-1 Error Code

author: Jordan Ramée
description:
Any attempt I've made to keep playing real-life volleyball in my 30s has led to me injuring myself in some way, so turning to volleyball video games has been my go-to for continuing to enjoy my favorite sport whenever I need to wait for my overworked knee to rest. 

No game has really gotten all that close to capturing the sensation of what it's like to play the sport, however. I was really hoping Grand Theft Auto 6 would satisfy that need somehow--beach volleyball is pretty big in any coastal place that's warm--but if there's a way to participate in a volleyball match in Rockstar's open world game the same way you can fish or play golf, I haven't found it.
title: All My Time Meant For GTA 6 This Week Is Being Taken Away By A Volleyball Game

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 is out now, and the game features a lot of music from famous real-world artists. But Doja Cat is not among them.

She's not happy about that, either.

Doja Cat said online that she is "so f**kin bitter" about that. In follow-up posts, she told Rockstar to "eat my d**k." She said she loves GTA 6, and being left out of the game breaks her heart. Directing
title: GTA 6 Doesn’t Have Any Doja Cat Music, And She Didn’t Censor Her Message To Rockstar

author: Callum Self
description:
Look, it’s Grand Theft Auto 6. Do I need to sell you on the game? Probably not. So, if you want to get it at a discount on Xbox, you can grab it from Fanatical for less than the retail price. For the rest of this article, I’ll be explaining why you should buy it at such a discount, but in reality, the fact that it’s already on sale should be reason enough. For those on the fence, here’s what else you should know.

I’ve done my waiting. 13 years of wondering, countless “we got X before GTA 6” memes, and ridiculous amounts of AI slop pretending to be Grand Theft Auto 6 leaks. The entire world has changed over and over since GTA 5’s release more than a decade ago, and now the series is back, with a duo of criminals leading the charge this time: Lucia Caminos and Jason Duval. Their relationship is the main focus of the game.
title: GTA 6 Is Finally Here, And You Can Get Both Editions Cheaper With This Xbox Deal

author: Chris Compendio
description:
The biggest pain point of Grand Theft Auto 6 is also one of the smallest and most monotonous actions you perform throughout the first chapter of the game.

One of the first things that the game teaches players is how to put money away into your secret stash, and it's made clear early in the story that stashing money away is essential to the game (you also lose all your pocket cash if you die or get arrested). If you want to stow cash underneath your floor, you'll have to select an amount to deposit using left and right on the D-pad. You'd assume that this would be a straightforward task, but this cash counter is sensitive as hell.

You can select dollar amounts one dollar at a time, but you'll presumably want to deposit a specific nu
title: The Worst Part Of Early GTA 6 Is Trying To Make A Damn Deposit

author: Eddie Makuch
description: Rockstar Games just launched Grand Theft Auto 6 on November 19 to rave reviews and huge sales. Everyone wants to know what's coming next, and surely there will eventually be another GTA game, but not soon.
title: GTA 7? Please, Let GTA 6 Cook First, Take-Two CEO Says

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
The Pokemon franchise turned 30 this year, and while you'll have to wait until next year for a new mainline game installment, you can celebrate that anniversary with something that's much cooler: Rock-and-roll-type electric guitars.

The Pokemon Company revealed that it teamed up with guitar manufacturer Fender to produce a Stratocaster model inspired by Pokemon Red, and a Telecaster model inspired by Pokemon Green. Each guitar features an aesthetic that pays tribute to the original Pokemon Game Boy adventures, including pixel art pulled from the games, graphics, and color overlays for an extra pop.

The guit
title: These Pokemon Anniversary Fender Guitars Have A Secret Weapon: Game Boy Sounds

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
The Prime Minister of the UK, Andy Burnham, has labeled Rockstar Games a "British success story" amid GTA 6's rave reviews and huge sales milestones.

A spokesperson for
title: GTA 6 Is A British Success Story, Prime Minister Says, But He Won’t Play It

author: Jason Rodriguez
description:
Let’s face it: You will get distracted often when playing Grand Theft Auto 6. One moment you’re on your way to start a mission, and the next you’re scouring the world for collectibles or tailing a high-end vehicle that you want to hijack. You might be curious as to how time passes in the game, and whether there are certain activities and content that you might miss out on.

Time advancement and campaign progression in Grand Theft Auto 6

You can check the current time in-game by opening the menu and looking at the upper-left corner of the screen. That said, time does advance at a fast rate in GTA 6--i.e. roughly one minute in-game for every five seconds in the real world.

However, if you’re in the middle of a miss
title: How Time Passes In GTA 6 And All Missable Content

author: Jason Rodriguez
description:
So, you’ve just had a long day at school/work and you feel like spending a few hours playing Grand Theft Auto 6. Initially, you might want to run a couple of missions, steal a few cars, or fly around in a fighter jet. But what if we told you that you could just sit your character’s butt on the sofa to try out the JoySystem? That’s right! If you don’t feel like exploring Leonida, you can just stay in the comfort of Jason’s home to play video games within a video game.

In This Article
title: All JoySystem Video Games In GTA 6

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Somehow, Cyberleek, the notorious hacker behind multiple Grand Theft Auto 6 leaks, has returned. This time, the infamous leaker is threatening to release the executable file for a working build of the Xbox version of the game hosted on their site, provided the public helps raise their meme coin to a $15 million market cap.

"It is done. CL holds the full November 2026 build of Grand Theft Auto 6, and it is going out by torrent," a statement from Cyberleek reads (via Kotaku). "Now. Every file except one--the main executable--held on a countdown. Honest terms, as always: it is an Xbox build this time, not a PC build. CL does not care. This community will have it emulated
title: Hacker Threatens To Leak Free Version Of GTA 6 In Crypto Grift

author: Jason Rodriguez
description:
Grand Theft Auto 6 offers non-stop action. You can spend numerous hours taking down rival gangsters, escaping from annoying cops, or just doing odd jobs to rake in a lot of dough. However, if you want something that’s more befuddling than usual, you can tackle intricate puzzles in a video game called Tenebrae Lux. We’ve got all the solutions for you in this guide.

In This Article
  • Tenebrae Lux and the JoySystem console
title: All Tenebrae Lux Puzzle Solutions In GTA 6

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Grand Theft Auto games have never shied away from satirizing life, and GTA 6 has plenty of digs at famous brands, trends, and people. Not even gaming is immune to GTA's patented satire, especially if you're playing on Xbox, because there's no escape from PlayStation — or its legally distinct cousin, the JoySystem.

Early in GTA 6, you'll get to bond with Jason's best pal, Cal. After maximizing the energy of Jason's bachelor pad with a little feng shui redecorating, the duo settles in for a night of booze, drugs, and video games on Booby's JoyStation console, which looks very similar to a PS5. It looks like this is the only gaming hardware in Leonida, since there are no Xbox Egg-Cube Stations X to play games on.
title: GTA 6’s Console Wars Are Already Over, And Xbox Lost

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
The truth is out there! Unidentified Flying Objects are once again whizzing around in Grand Theft Auto 6, but compared to previous games, you can have a close encounter of the third kind this time. So far, two distinct UFO mysteries have been revealed in GTA 6, and if you're looking to meet visitors from another world, here's how you can find them.

Alien encounter 1: The abduction
title: GTA 6 Has Aliens, And Here’s How To Find Them

author: Jason Rodriguez
description:
Grand Theft Auto 6, much like its predecessors in the hit series, is chock-full of strange and mysterious happenings. One activity, in particular, has you scrounging the state of Leonida in search of odd stuff. Some of these just look a bit off, while others seem as though they don’t even belong in our world. If you manage to scan these using your app, they can be tallied as part of your WAiNK Curiosities collection.

In This Article
title: All WAiNK Curiosities In GTA 6

author: Jason Rodriguez
description:
There are a total of 31 WAiNK Landmarks in Grand Theft Auto 6. Similar to other related points-of-interest, these structures dot the towns and counties of Leonida, and you have to keep your eyes peeled if you want to find all of them.

In This Article
  • WAiNK Landmarks in Mariana County
    • WAiNK Landmark #1: Badger
title: All WAiNK Landmarks In GTA 6

author: Jason Rodriguez
description:
The vistas of Leonida in Grand Theft Auto 6 have their fair share of artworks and architecture made by skilled craftsmen. In the same vein, there are also unique WAiNK Sculptures found in various locations. All of these can be scanned using the trusty WAiNK app on your phone.

In This Article
  • WAiNK Sculptures in Mariana County
title: All WAiNK Sculptures In GTA 6

author: Jason Rodriguez
description:
Fancy spending some time reading stuff in Grand Theft Auto 6? There are plenty of magazines, books, and comics for you to find in the game. Some offer insights about life in Leonida, while others are humorous jabs and general whimsy. There are even ones that offer additional information, with points-of-interest that get marked on your map.

Magazines, Books, and Comics in Mariana County

The first major zone in the game, Mariana County, has several reading materials for you to discover. In fact, a bunch of them can be found inside Jason’s home.

Note: We don’t want to spoil all the details, but make sure you read all the books and
title: All Magazines, Books, And Comics In GTA 6

author: Joey Carr
description:
It goes without saying that, at some point, you're going to lose, damage, or destroy your favorite car in Grand Theft Auto 6. It's a rite of passage in the GTA world, and with how fragile some vehicles can be in Leonida, you're going to need to retrieve your car at one time or another.

However, sometimes losing a car or motorcycle is out of your control, especially if you're doing story missions or side content. GTA 6 will often remove your vehicle from the map or replace it with another, leaving you wondering how to get your previous vehicle back. Whether your vehicle's been replaced, lost, damaged, or destroyed, we have you covered with all the methods to retrieve it in GTA 6.
title: How To Retrieve All Lost And Damaged Cars In GTA 6

author: Jake Dekker
description: Money is important in GTAVI, and each chapter introduces new ways to earn cash. Here are some of the best ways to make money in each chapter.
title: How To Make Money Fast In GTA 6

author: Joey Carr
description:
Leonida is a state with plenty of powerful machinery. From high-powered weapons to devastatingly fast vehicles, you can have quite the arsenal at your disposal in Grand Theft Auto 6. However, if you're searching for the ultimate combination of weapons and transportation, then you'll want to get your hands on a tank.

For decades in GTA, tanks have been the vehicle that players use when they want to go on a true six-star Wanted level rampage. Tanks are extremely difficult to take down, have a variety of weapons to use, and can crush anything in their path. Naturally, a vehicle as powerful as a tank is going to be difficult to obtain, but in GTA 6, there's just one location where you can acquire one.

W
title: How To Get A Tank In GTA 6

author: Joey Carr
description:
Weapons are arguably the most important items that you can equip for Jason and Lucia in Grand Theft Auto 6. Whether it's a pistol that helps with sticky situations or an assault rifle for elaborate robberies, you need a weapon on both characters at all times to survive in Leonida.

While GTA 6 features over 100 unique weapons to find and use, just picking one up doesn't automatically mean you get to keep it equipped for the rest of the game. Rockstar Games has completely reworked the weapons system, and you need to take some extra steps to save any weapons that you find or have used in the past.
title: How To Save Guns And Weapons You Find In GTA 6
